t: Nothing remains of St Thomas the Apostle, which stood on St Thomas Apostle Street in the City of London. The parish church existed by the late twelfth century. It was destroyed in the Great Fire of 1666 and never rebuilt. Lady Catherine Killigrew, a gentlewoman and scholar and wife of Sir Henry Killigrew, is buried here. Sir William Fitzwilliam died here. He was a Merchant Taylor, Sheriff of London, a servant of Cardinal Wolsey, and a member of Henry the Seventh's council.
